maintenance_led.reason: Executive search, talent consulting and leadership assessment engagements for corporate clients; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mainly private corporations (Fortune-ranked companies) paying for executive search and organizational consulting.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through search and consulting services; acquisitions such as Hay Group were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consulting and executive search are project-based; clients can switch to competing firms without major disruption or requalification.
